name: @piyawasin/attempt
description: A minimal, type-safe utility for defensive error handling in JS/TS. Inspired by Go, it uses tuple-based returns to eliminate try-catch nesting and handle synchronous/asynchronous errors predictably.

scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:major: npm version major && npm publish --access public

author: Piyawasin Pikror-ngarn
